en.text:
Scoring 35% of the Base Magazine Capacity as Precision Hits grants 25% increased damage for #e${11+#d} seconds.

Stowing or Reloading the weapon resets the Precision Hit counter. The buff remains active while stowed.

#ExplosiveBuffExclusion

enhanced (
var d = 1
#e Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.
)
